key.name: zoom-out-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for the zoom-out animation that expands workspaces when a drag begins and the window has been held long enough.

key.name: zoom-in-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for the zoom-in animation that restores the workspace layout when a drag ends.

key.name: zoom-out-hold-delay
key.summary: Hold delay before engaging spatial layout
key.description: Milliseconds the window must be held before the spatial zoom-out engages. 0 disables the hold: every drag (even a click) engages immediately, and the upstream drop fall-through path described in commit 54bee12 no longer applies.

key.name: zoom-easing
key.description: Clutter.AnimationMode applied to both zoom-in and zoom-out. Options: EASE_OUT_QUAD (default), EASE_OUT_CUBIC, EASE_OUT_EXPO, EASE_OUT_BACK.
